_comment: Base buildings (scripts/bases.gd). cost (gold), days to build, upkeep (gold a day), needs (other buildings first), and what it does. Effects are implemented by id; numbers live here. visibility: how much it gives the base away each day.

dock.name: Dock
dock.description: A proper landing. Lets you leave prizes here, and every other building needs it.

careening_yard.name: Careening yard
careening_yard.description: A beach and tackle for heeling a ship over. Careen here for nothing, in two days.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Store plunder and goods safely: if you strike your colours at sea, what's here stays here.

tavern.name: Tavern
tavern.description: Rum, music and company. Sailors drift in looking for a berth, and a visit does the crew good.

shipyard.name: Shipyard
shipyard.description: Shipwrights and timber. Repairs here cost half what a port charges.

battery.name: Battery
battery.description: Guns dug in above the anchorage. Fires on raiders, and beside you if you're here.

fort.name: Fort
fort.description: Stone walls and heavy guns. A raid needs a fleet to take it.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.description: A lookout on the high ground: warns of raids days ahead and shows ships near the cove on your chart.

plantation.name: Plantation
plantation.description: Cleared land and a few fields. Sugar and tobacco into the warehouse, and smoke on the horizon. It needs 15 field hands beyond the five who keep the base: short-handed, it grows less.

distillery.name: Distillery
distillery.description: Turns molasses (bring it in) or the plantation's sugar into rum: worth more, and the crew want it. Needs 5 hands at the stills.

smugglers_market.name: Smugglers' market
smugglers_market.description: Traders who don't ask questions. Stolen goods sell here at full price.

stockade.name: Stockade
stockade.description: Hold hostages here and a go-between collects their ransom: half again what a port pays.
